objective: Handle rare predecessors without rejecting a supported marker grammar, and avoid destructive unit choices when an admissible interpretation retains the sign as a genuine letter. Test actual message recovery with unknown keys and fixed-rule transfer. Ambiguity is not success.
timing: Known phase28 c012,c013,c017,c035 are development regressions, never new validation. Run their unit-only regressions before freeze. Freeze protocol, sources, availability, code, seeds, metrics and stop rules before all new generation, fitting or measurements. Local freeze, not external preregistration or human blinding.
change: Retain every predecessor whose every observed occurrence is followed by the candidate marker, even if seen once. Require at least4 frequent predecessors with >=5 occurrences, >=100 total markers, and every marker explained by such a predecessor. Retain all admissible grammars instead of maximizing deletion mechanisms. No likelihood-based grammar selection, no use of true answers to rank outputs. A frequent terminal-only symbol on some but not all words triggers an unsupported-pattern abstention, because optional insertion is outside this grammar and the symbol may be a real letter.
unit_rules: Minimum100 fit words. Enumerate no terminal deletion and a dedicated constant terminal on every word, leaving all words nonempty and absent inside words. For each choice enumerate no shared marker and each shared marker satisfying the stated support and complete pairing rules. Keep only candidates with <=26 surviving symbol types. Partial-terminal hazard: symbol occurs >=100 times, every occurrence is word-final, and fewer than all words contain it. Hazard overrides release, without deleting anything. Else0 candidates => outside_grammar,1 => unique,more => ambiguous. No morphology, arbitrary homophony or arbitrary multigraph grammar is claimed.
sources: Byte-exact phase28 snapshots and normalized corpora: Apuleius Metamorphoses, Manzoni I promessi sposi. Same Caesar and Dante reference models. Entire source files and their normalizations were already available in phase28; only the selected new ranges are disjoint from evaluated old ranges. No new author, new manuscript reserve or analyst-blind text is claimed. Pinned source provenance and rights retained.
new_partitions: Three pairs per language. Fit1000 whole words at starts12000,16000,20000; skip100; transfer400 words. All fit/test ranges disjoint within source and disjoint from phase28 ranges0..1500,4000..5500,8000..9500, with margins>100 words. Same six base pairs across six encoding variants:24 supported positives plus12 outside-family challenges; not36 independent passages. Supplied language and normalized word spaces, noiseless ciphertext.
positive_variants: Six pairs times4: monoalphabetic; dedicated terminal marker on every word; one dedicated shared marker after a random fixed subset of12 letters; both mechanisms. Same opaque26-to28-symbol substitution across paired variants. Encryption is invertible; keys not supplied to fit/scoring. Each letter is initially one base symbol; extra symbols have no base-letter alignment.
outside_family: Six pairs times2. Distinct digraphs: every letter has a distinct second symbol,26 extra symbols. Partial terminal: dedicated sign added to even-indexed words only, same rule in fit/test. Reversible known-message cases outside the shared-marker/constant-terminal grammar. Require abstention rather than a confidently released wrong model. Do not replace failures with easier cases.
no_null_adversaries: Eight new cases: per language, two samples of reference tokens with a unique final a or e (1000 fit/400 transfer, independently seeded); one synthetic string made of pa,ta,ma,sa,na,e,i,o,u,r units, with genuine a and no inserted symbol; one alternating sample with genuine final a on half the words and no a on the other half. All are encoded by plain monoalphabetic substitution. Ground-truth alignment marks every plaintext letter as genuine. Includes terminal, internal-pair and partial-terminal ambiguities. Reused reference vocabulary/grammar, newly generated realizations; not independent natural-language texts.
structured_controls: Four first-order character Markov samples, two per reference language, with empirical initial letters, transitions and word lengths,1000 fit/400 transfer. Combined encoding. No chosen literary passage. Inherits language statistics and may emit meaningful words. Exact algebraic recovery, candidate coverage or abstention is not a meaning detector.
regressions: Reproduce exact cipher/plaintext pairs and keys from phase28 c012,c013,c017,c035 separately as four exposed cases. Include them in full branch fitting after freeze but exclude them from ALL new validation denominators and gates. Pre-freeze unit regressions require true units retained and no released reading; those tests do not establish text recovery.
solver: Byte-exact phase28/18 C++ solver. Supplied reference language;27-symbol character4grams alpha0.01; frequency smoothing0.5; divergence weight4; anchor26;8 restarts;60000 steps;temp0.002; existing final greedy passes. One independently seeded fit per admissible grammar, in fixed enumeration order, for unique or ambiguous cases. No fits for outside/hazard abstentions. Scores saved diagnostically, not used to choose grammars or alternatives. No extra attempts after failure. Branches share passages and reference models.
transfer: Finish every fit before any transfer predictions. Apply all fitted rules and keys unchanged. Missing symbols become '?'; rule violations explicit. Unique fit releases only if transfer has no unseen symbol and no rule violation; otherwise transfer_abstention. Ambiguous fits remain ambiguous even if transfer rules invalidate alternatives: never promote a branch using transfer. Answers opened by evaluation only after every prediction is written. No best-answer lookup in the operational pipeline.
access_boundary: The fitter verifies only frozen code, protocol and reference models; it does not read new-author plaintexts, regression answers, generation keys or the sealed tree, even for source hashes. Full input integrity is checked separately outside fitting. C++ reads only LM, reference frequency and integer ciphertext. This is audited software separation, not OS access isolation or external human blinding.
metrics: For released outputs distinguish exact transfer, exact fit, unit identification, seen-letter key accuracy, complete26-letter key status, and edit distances. Complete key is incomplete if unobserved base-symbol identities are not mapped; transfer exactness does not imply complete key. True unit identity requires correct units in BOTH fit and transfer. For all cases report abstention status, candidate count, and diagnostic availability of the true units/exact transfer among alternatives; these are NEVER exact recovery. Count erroneous removals using explicit essential cipher-position alignment, separately in fit/test and for released outputs versus unchosen branches. No-null denominator includes6 plain literary mono controls plus8 adversaries=14. Outside denominator12. New positives24. New cases48, exposed regressions4, total52.

gates.mechanical: All specified fixtures pass before new generation. Mechanical defects stop for diagnosis; no silent alteration of frozen files.
gates.recovery: ALL24 new positive variants must release a single reading with exact transfer text AND true units on both passages. Any ambiguity, abstention, wrong unit or wrong letter fails. Fit plaintext and full-key accuracy are mandatory separate metrics, not substitutes for this predefined gate.
gates.false_removal: Zero released genuine-character removals in fit and transfer across ALL14 new no-null cases. Report number of cases, words and letters, not merely a percentage. Also report incorrect candidate deletions that remain unchosen.
gates.unsupported: ALL12 unsupported-family cases must abstain. A released reading on an unsupported case counts as a false acceptance even if accidentally readable.
gates.combined: All three new-data gates must pass. Do not reward an always-abstaining method: it fails recovery. Regression success and true-answer inclusion in alternatives do not satisfy any new recovery gate.

stop: One frozen pass and software replay. No relaxed threshold, new candidate ranking, favorable case filtering, additional random restarts or manual key repair after outcomes. Preserve every failure and abstention. Calibration-only phase; no Voynich application in this protocol, regardless of result. Failed gates explicitly prohibit transfer. Further development requires a new protocol and fresh ranges. No historic decryption claim without independent predictions and external validation.

Software replication is distinct from external historical/linguistic verification, which has not occurred.
